thread:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp for Ruby is flaky for one customer. After the initial token refresh we sometimes see a 401 on the next request and the SDK doesn't retry the same way Go does. Repro below. Anyone seen this?

sam: can you paste the minimal repro + gem version?

alex: repro steps:
1) checkout sampleapp-ruby v0.6.1
2) run with a short-lived token (expires in 5s)
3) flow: get token -> make request -> token refresh on 401 -> subsequent request returns 401 (no retry)

logs:```
I, [2026-03-24T09:12:01.123Z]  INFO -- request: POST /v1/generate 200
I, [2026-03-24T09:12:06.456Z]  WARN -- request: POST /v1/generate 401 auth error
I, [2026-03-24T09:12:06.457Z]  INFO -- token_refresh: succeeded
I, [2026-03-24T09:12:06.458Z]  WARN -- retry: giving up, no retry attempted
```

maria: hmm looks like the retry policy in ruby-sdk v1.3.0 changed last month (switched to optimistic auth path). Could be we dropped the automatic token-refresh+retry atomicity.

oliver: customer reported it only for our onprem install behind an auth proxy. Might be timing + connection pooling.

sam: I briefly scanned recent commits — there is a PR that refactors auth middleware (https://github.com/redwoodinc/ruby-sdk/pull/412). It tried to avoid double-retries, but I think the logic now only refreshes token but doesn't re-dispatch the original request.

alex: reproduced against master too. Happy to open a tiny PR but wanted to check if we prefer: 1) re-send original request after refresh (simple), or 2) make refresh+retry atomic inside middleware (cleaner but touchy).

maria: prefer option 2. If we just re-send outside middleware we risk losing idempotency guarantees for non-idempotent endpoints. But for onboarding sampleapp requests are idempotent so quick fix is acceptable as a stopgap.

sam: ok for short-term let's implement re-send of the original request only for 401 auth errors and only when a successful refresh occurs. Add a config flag SDK_OPTIMISTIC_AUTH=false for set-and-forget rollouts.

oliver: note we should also update sampleapp README and include a test that simulates token expiry. Customer QA will want a patch release too.

ci-bot: test/unit/auth_middleware_test.rb: auth retry on token refresh — FAILED (0.2s)

sam: right, will open a PR with tests. Minimal patch: wrap dispatch in a retry block, ensure headers are replaced with refreshed token, and record telemetry event `auth_retry` for observability.

alex: thanks — can you @maria on the PR for approval? I'll add a minimal repro script to /scripts/repro_token_expiry.rb and link in the issue.

maria: yep will review. Also let's add a note in CHANGELOG about the config flag and the semantic version bump (minor).

oliver: can we do a patch release (v1.3.1) with the small fix and then follow up with the middleware atomic rewrite in v1.4? Customer needs it asap.

sam: that's fine. I'll target a hotfix branch and cutting a release once tests pass.

alex: posted the repro script and the failing trace in the GH issue: https://github.com/redwoodinc/ruby-sdk/issues/789 — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: quick reminder — if anyone touches retry behavior also verify it with Streaming endpoints (they behave differently).

sam: noted. I'll add a streaming smoke test.

oliver: customer support note: will send ETA once PR is merged.

alex: cool, closing the loop here. If you need the customer logs ping me.
